## Roles and industries
- [Chief of Staff, remote](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/roles/chief-of-staff): Senior management team of a 50+ person school. Workforce grew from about 24 to 53 in one year.
- [Executive Assistant to CEO, remote](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/roles/executive-assistant): Supported a Senior Vice President of Investment at Kidder Mathews with transactions, listings and correspondence.
- [Operations Manager, remote](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/roles/operations-manager): Designed the processes, forms and reports behind a school that grew from about 24 to 53 staff.
- [Marketing Operations Specialist](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/roles/marketing-operations): Six email automation workflows and an 83.57% click-to-open rate for a real estate coach.
- [AI Automation Specialist](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/roles/ai-automation): Five free sample workflows and three past systems, each with its human check written down.
- [Real estate operations support](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/industries/real-estate): Kidder Mathews, Yokly and a real estate coach: executive support, staff training and email automation.
- [School operations and people support](https://ciarramazaredo.vercel.app/industries/education): Head of People & Culture on the senior management team of a school that grew to 53 staff.
